notes: DRAFT side file: which evolution line and stage each species sits in. Generated by Tools/bestiary/assign_species_lines.js. method: name = the species name is a stage label; keyword = a name keyword chose the line, stage guessed from rank; family = the family default, stage guessed from rank; base = a variant inherits its base species. Stage-from-rank is a placement guess for review; threat rank is never inferred from stage. Unassigned species belong to game families the bible has no group for.
